retrievalProfile.description: A three-panel triptych layout featuring central full-body figures and flanking portraits framed by organic Art Nouveau curves and psychedelic floral motifs.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, hand-drawn composition characterized by three vertical arched panels. The central panel features a full-length figure surrounded by lilies, while side panels contain circular portrait frames above decorative mandalas. The style blends the flowing lines of Art Nouveau with the bold, saturated colors and distorted typography of 1960s psychedelia.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic floral elements weaving through geometric frames
High-contrast ink outlines against soft watercolor gradients
Integration of text into the decorative border system
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink outlines for all subjects and frames
Floral motifs (lilies) as primary decorative elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure is full-scale and dominant; side portraits are scaled down and positioned in the upper third of the flanking panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's white dress provides a high-value anchor against the colorful background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement from the top display text, down through the central figure, and out to the side panels via the curved framing lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with patterns, flowers, and text, typical of horror vacui in psychedelic art.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (ochre, brown, tan) in the background washes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the central figure and floral highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pinks, yellows, and purples within the mandalas and lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in decorative details contrasted with desaturated, textured watercolor backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, heavy-weight display sans-serif with liquid-like distortions.
letterConstructionRules: Thick black outlines with inner color fills
Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that flow into the frame
Variable stroke width with bulbous terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'U' are stretched to follow the curvature of the frame
The dot of the 'I' is replaced by a sun motif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair heavy display bubble lettering with small, clean sans-serif for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing structure of the frames

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a triptych watercolor illustration with three arched panels. The center panel features a woman in a white dress surrounded by lilies. The side panels feature circular portraits above intricate mandalas. Use ink outlines and warm watercolor washes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom bubble lettering in the top and bottom margins. The text should have thick black outlines and follow the curve of the arches. Use a pink-to-white gradient fill for the letters.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct arched panels?
Is the lettering thick, rounded, and outlined in black?
Do the floral elements overlap the panel borders?
Is the color palette dominated by watercolor textures?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in side panels
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact song titles or artist names
postGenerationChecks: Check for thick black ink outlines on all elements
Ensure the triptych structure is clearly defined
Verify the lettering is integrated into the overall frame
Confirm the presence of floral motifs weaving through the composition
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Floral Motif] in a [Triptych Arched Layout] using [Psychedelic Bubble Lettering] and [Watercolor Ink Style].
